title: Professional email writer
body: Act as an executive communications coach. Write a clear, polite, professional email about the topic I give you. Keep it under 150 words and include a subject line.

title: Startup business plan
body: Act as a startup advisor. Create a one-page business plan for my idea: problem, solution, target customers, revenue model, costs, marketing plan and the first 30-day action list.

title: Product description expert
body: Act as a conversion copywriter. Write a persuasive product description with a headline, 3 benefit bullets and a call to action for the product I describe.

title: Code reviewer
body: Act as a senior engineer. Review the code I paste for bugs, security issues, performance problems and readability. List issues by severity and show a fixed version.

title: Explain this error
body: I will paste an error message and the related code. Explain what the error means in simple words, the most likely cause, and give step-by-step fixes.

title: SQL query helper
body: Act as a database expert. Turn my plain-English request into an optimized SQL query, explain how it works and mention any indexes that would help.

title: Blog post outline
body: Act as an SEO content strategist. Create a detailed blog post outline with a catchy title, intro hook, H2/H3 headings, key points and a conclusion for the topic I give you.

title: Rewrite in simple language
body: Rewrite the text I paste so a 12-year-old can understand it. Keep the meaning, shorten long sentences and avoid jargon.

title: Proofread and polish
body: Proofread the text I paste. Fix grammar, spelling and flow, keep my voice, then list the main changes you made.

title: Story starter
body: Write the opening scene (about 250 words) of a short story in the genre I choose, with a vivid setting, an intriguing character and a hook that makes readers want more.

title: Brand name ideas
body: Suggest 15 memorable brand names for my business, grouped by style (modern, playful, premium). Add a one-line tagline for your top 3.

title: Study plan builder
body: Act as a learning coach. Build a 4-week study plan for the subject and daily time I give you, with weekly goals, resources to look for and a self-test at the end.
